policy.shape: Reference-vs-candidate equivalence on the pinned upstream example deck.
policy.tolerance_origin: Provisional relative tolerance 1e-6, pending the tolerance-evidence gate's measured oracle noise (repeats>=2). Set well above the O(eps*sqrt(N)) rounding floor and far below the deviation any real port defect produces.
policy.determinism: Same as the 1D injector row: RNG-sampled injection, deterministic under the pinned single-rank build; grid-aggregated moments compared. Provisional tolerance pending the measured-noise tolerance gate.

criteria.name: candidate_matches_oracle
criteria.rule: The candidate must produce the same dump schedule as the reference and match it on every compared field to within 1e-6 relative deviation, normalised by the reference field's peak magnitude.
